title: Anonymous 1,000-product apparel retailer (GrowthRock link-bar study): mobile link bar (flat)

change.control: Mobile homepage relies on hamburger navigation.
change.variant: Expose horizontally scrollable category links in a link bar while retaining the hamburger menu.

significance.reported: 93% under a traditional calculation; Optimizely two-tailed engine did not declare significance

quote: After 28 days, we saw a 5% increase with 93% statistical significance
notes: Publisher calls it likely a winner but explicitly below the 95% convention and not significant in Optimizely. Over 80,000 visitors and 2,300 conversions per arm reported without exact counts. Category pageviews +10–12% at >99% significance; no separate record for secondary metrics.
